visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with a white beaded headband and beige sweater sits in a room with light wooden floors; a white cat walks across the background while she speaks to the camera with an expressive face. (2) She attempts to hold the cat, which wriggles away, and she then shows a small scab on her thumb to the lens, gesturing with her other hand. (3) She holds up a large bright pink shopping bag with 'NEW FLAGSHIP' printed in black, moving it closer to reveal items inside. (4) She presents three blister packs of 'Cathy Doll' elephant lip balms in yellow, purple, and red, holding them grouped in front of her chest. (5) Close-up shot of her hand rotating a small orange translucent elephant figure, highlighting the 'C/D' logo on its back and its smiling face. (6) She places three elephant figures in yellow, pink, and orange on a shelf next to books and a designer speaker. (7) She removes the head of the yellow elephant to reveal a pink lipstick bullet and applies it to her lips while looking directly at the camera. (8) She transitions to applying the pink elephant lipstick, which has a darker shade, and she points to her lip contours. (9) She holds the yellow and pink elephant heads next to each other, comparing the shades and textures while explaining the differences. (10) She applies the orange elephant balm, demonstrating the precision of the small applicator on her upper and lower lips. (11) The woman holds all three packaged lip balms again, smiling broadly and gesturing with enthusiasm toward the camera.

(2) A 'bubble pop' SFX triggers when the cat appears, followed by her laughing tone. (3) A sharp 'ding' SFX marks the transition as she shows the shopping bag. (4) Cartoon-style 'slide' SFX plays as she fans out the lip balm products. (5) Her vocal tone shifts to informative as she begins the product close-up, accompanied by UI 'click' sound effects. (6) Each application of the lipstick is punctuated by a subtle 'whoosh' or 'sparkle' SFX. (7) The BGM maintains a consistent, upbeat rhythm, providing a energetic backdrop to her rapid-fire Chinese speech. (8) The audio concludes with a final 'ding' and a cheerful vocal sign-off.
